status: FROZEN by the Chair in D-046 §3 (4 Oct 2026). Never re-drawn. Every game on these maps is held out of every training and validation set for the whole phase.
rule: Within each C7-03 class with more than one map, sort the LIVE_MAPS_M2 names ascending and take index int(sha256('D-046/' + class letter), 16) mod n. A: autarky, default, devil, queen_of_spades, stripes, tower_defense, trophy -> index 6. B: australia, islands, maze, schooltime, unsw -> index 2. C: dilemma, trauma, weakhold -> index 1. Classes D (slithery_fight) and E (portals) have one map each and are covered by held-out series.
scope: Held out by map name in every map_era. The sha256 values are the post-m2 templates from docs/maps-live.md; Data adds the store's map_hash values and per-split row counts in its own manifest.
series_rule: bucket = int(sha256('D-046/' + series id), 16) mod 10; 0 = test, 1 = validation, 2-9 = train; whole series only.
gate_seeds: 1-3 gate, 4-5 reserve, training rollouts use seeds >= 1000.
